summary: Tested the new APInex Chingu AI reply integration (backend only). /api/chat now uses APInex (api.apinex.bond, model free/gpt-6-luna) as primary engine with Gemini fallback. Verified via direct API calls + log inspection + code review + full regression pytest suite (92 tests).

minor.issue: test_emergent_preview_routing.py fails on 2 tests because /app/frontend/eas.json does not exist (unrelated to this APInex change, pre-existing gap from earlier iterations).

action_items: Optional: restore/add /app/frontend/eas.json (or update test_emergent_preview_routing.py) to resolve 2 unrelated pre-existing test failures - not caused by this iteration's change.
No action needed for the APInex integration itself - working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: apinex_llm.py: clean implementation, correctly raises on empty key/empty response/network error so caller can fall back; retry with backoff (1 retry) is reasonable.

server.py chat_buddy(): apinex_configured() gate + try/except correctly falls back to stream_llm_text(get_llm) on any APInex exception, and engine_used label is logged accurately ('Chingu chat reply generated via apinex' vs gemini) - confirms correct primary/fallback wiring.
No business logic touched in translate/tts/transcribe/pronounce-score paths - confirmed via regression suite, all passing.

success_rate.frontend: not tested this iteration (backend-only change, frontend chat UI unaffected per scope)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed chat sessions (TEST_sess_*) via /api/chat for verification; these are isolated test session_ids in db.chat_sessions and do not affect production data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: APInex integration verified working end-to-end: POST /api/chat returns HTTP 200 with non-empty reply for both no practice_lang and practice_lang='ko' cases; backend logs confirmed 'Chingu chat reply generated via apinex' for all test calls (APINEX_API_KEY is present at runtime via secrets injection, not visible in backend/.env file directly - this is expected/by design). Fallback code path (apinex fails -> Gemini via stream_llm_text/get_llm) reviewed and is correctly implemented, not force-broken to test live since APINEX_API_KEY is live. Full regression pytest suite run (92 tests): 90 passed, 2 failed due to pre-existing missing /app/frontend/eas.json file (unrelated to this change - was already failing before this iteration based on file absence, not a result of apinex work). Admin login, admin settings, translate, translate-image, tts, transcribe, pronounce-score, chat history persistence, languages, health/ping all passing.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no RCA needed, feature working as intended. The eas.json failures are a pre-existing gap: file simply does not exist in frontend directory; test_emergent_preview_routing.py expects it for EAS build profile validation, unrelated to the APInex chat scope of this review.
